description: Attempt a purchase for a quote_id from prepare_order using an explicitly selected buyer_mode and payment_method supported by payment_capabilities. stripe_checkout requires human/delegated confirmation, accepted terms, customer email and a customer-paid Stripe link; agent_wallet and stripe_off_session are available only when their offline-sandbox capabilities are enabled and the machine has the necessary authority or balance. This can create an order or start a payment; reuse the SAME idempotency_key on retries and never infer success before verified payment.
